R409.note: toRealPath() on base and target plus startsWith containment correctly closes the symlink/traversal vector; requiring the target to exist is no new restriction since Files.readAllBytes already required existence.

R410.note: Replaces hand-built RESP with StackExchange.Redis IDatabase.Execute("HSET", args) passing each field as a separate RedisValue, correctly closing CRLF/command injection; the Socket->IConnectionMultiplexer constructor change is the necessary, openly-shown consequence of switching to a real client library.

R411.note: Tika content-sniffing, random UUID filename, and storage outside webroot correctly close CWE-434, but the new MIME allowlist and 10MB size cap are restrictions the original endpoint never had and could reject file types/sizes it previously accepted; disclosed openly.

R412.note: ObjectInputFilter pattern "evalcases.OrderEvent;java.*" has no trailing "!*"; verified by running the exact createFilter pattern against a non-listed class in JDK 26 that it returns UNDECIDED (not REJECTED), which ObjectInputStream treats as allowed, so the deserialization proceeds and the CWE-502 vector remains open.

R413.note: Standard SecureRandom 16-byte token base64-encoded replaces Math.random(); shared static instance is thread-safe, no other observable behavior changes.

R414.note: Regex validation correctly blocks CRLF injection into the raw SMTP commands, but requires the full local@domain email shape rather than just excluding control characters, a character-bound restriction the original never had that could reject legitimately-shaped but unusual addresses (e.g. quoted local parts) the original code accepted.

R415.note: Filter pattern "cases.deserialize.RestoredSession;java.base/*;!*" correctly closes the vector; verified by running the exact pattern in JDK 26 that it allows RestoredSession/java.base classes and REJECTS an unlisted class via the trailing !*, matching the stated contract.

R416.note: Removes the shell invocation and writes the parameter directly, matching the endpoint's original echo-only purpose with no new escaping gap beyond what the original subprocess-echo path already had.

R417.note: Canonicalize-and-containment check (toRealPath/getCanonicalFile + startsWith) correctly closes the traversal vector; the added literal ".." substring pre-check is redundant defense-in-depth that could in a narrow edge case reject a filename containing a literal ".." substring, but the real defense doesn't depend on it.

R418.note: Build FAILs (CS0119: System.IO.File ambiguous with inherited ControllerBase.File); independent of that, the fix removes report generation entirely and only reads a pre-existing static file, so the "generate" endpoint no longer generates anything for any report not already present, framed misleadingly as "preserving the original return behavior".

R419.note: Allowlist-map lookup correctly eliminates the traversal/arbitrary-module vector per the CWE-22 JS guidance's own recommended pattern, but hardcoding only 3 plugin names is a new restriction versus the original's open-ended "any *.js file under ./plugins/" behavior and could reject legitimate plugin names not in the map; disclosed openly.

R420.note: JSTL <c:out> with default escapeXml=true correctly closes the reflected XSS with no change to output for benign displayName values.
